title: 第三三七章 尘埃落定第三三六章 太一魔君战九阳道君
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 轰！
麾下四位金丹真君全部陨落，九阳道君完全无法维持住元神，瞬间跌落元婴境！
太一魔君掌中的万劫崩灭落下，其中蕴含恐怖的大地玄黄之力，将九阳道君一掌拍成了齑粉！
偌大道基，炎阳净土显化于世！
刺啦！
玉清道君的剑好似斩破了空间，相隔十八万里，一剑将太一魔君斩得血流如注，胸口呈现一道巨大伤痕。
太一魔君浑然不顾这伤势，张开手摄住只剩下金丹圆满之境的九阳神魂，得意非凡，“哈哈哈哈！”
“九阳已死，你们要与我和云胤、玄极、龙君、明月分个高低吗？”
“二打五，好好想想！”
“本座此行，只为替多宝寻个公道，这炎阳净土和九阳的传承，我不会动，全都交给吕洞阳！”
玄天仙门。
玄天道君起身，看向太一魔君，又看向紫月净土之中的吕洞阳。
他是真没想到九阳居然会死！
元婴大战，动辄一月！
谁能想到，吕洞阳居然叛变了？
真要拼的话，他也能拼死一个元婴，可自己呢，玄天仙门呢？
在这八荒，胜者通吃！
谁家最后能活下来元婴境，谁就能吞掉所有的造化！
玉清山再次隐世。
死了的元婴，在玉清道君眼里，是没有任何价值的。
玄天道君痛苦地闭上了双眼。
“这玄云之地局势大变，得跟玉清好好谈谈了。”
“若是谈不成，就只能隐世，或是遁走天荒，才能让天奇继承我的道统了。”
至于太一魔君说的什么九阳的传承给吕洞阳的话，狗都不信！
他寿元无多，虽是战力巅峰，但对面的元婴有点太多了！
之前的玄云之地，他们这边三位元婴互保，互相保证对方能够转世归来，传承有序。
但现在，不太好说了。
玄云之地，由于李水生在到处搞事，扶立玄极，又弄死了九阳，局势大变了！
九阳魔门，李水生和金鳌娘娘战得正酣。
李水生接连拍出乾坤造化掌，打得金鳌娘娘咳血不止。
但万里之外，一切已经尘埃落定。
玄天道君和玉清道君终究还是选择了低头。
金鳌娘娘心中怒道：“这九阳怎么如此废物！”
“死得也太快了，好歹挣扎一下，将玄天玉清牵扯进来啊！”
“罢了，已经弄死了两位人族元婴，不错了。”
“若是继续挑拨，会让人族生疑，发现我等筹谋的大事！”
金鳌娘娘朝着李水生笑道：“这一次虽然没能完全达成计划，但也完成了部分。”
“这一次就不陪你玩了，我们终将再会！”
烈阳真君身上的金色丝线消失，金鳌娘娘放开了烈阳真君的控制。
烈阳真君感受到金鳌娘娘已经离开，浑身颤抖着看向李水生。
李水生笑道：“你什么你？”
content_en:
boom!
All four Jindan True Lords under his command fell. Jiuyang Taoist Lord was completely unable to maintain his soul and fell into the Nascent Soul realm in an instant!
The Ten Thousand Calamities in Taiyi Demon Lord's palm collapsed, and it contained the terrifying black and yellow power of the earth. It turned Jiuyang Dao Lord into powder with one palm!
With such a great foundation, the Pure Land of Yanyang appears in the world!
Stab!
Taoist Yuqing's sword seemed to have cut through the space. He was 180,000 miles away. With one sword, he slashed Taiyi Demon Lord until he was bleeding profusely and a huge scar appeared on his chest.
Regardless of the injury, Taiyi Demon Lord opened his hand to catch the Jiuyang Soul, which was only in the perfect state of the golden elixir. He was extremely proud and said, "Hahahaha!"
"Jiu Yang is dead, do you want to differentiate between me, Yun Yin, Xuan Ji, Long Jun, and Mingyue?"
"Two against five, think about it!"
"I am here just to seek justice for Duobao. I will not touch the inheritance of Yanyang Pure Land and Jiuyang. I will leave it all to Lu Dongyang!"
Xuantian Immortal Gate.
Daojun Xuantian stood up, looked at Taiyi Demon Lord, and then looked at Lu Dongyang in Ziyue Pure Land.
"Alas!"
He really didn't expect Jiuyang to die!
The Nascent Soul War can only take a month!
Who would have thought that Lu Dongyang would actually rebel?
If he really wanted to fight, he could fight to death a Nascent Soul, but what about himself and the Xuantian Immortal Sect?
In this world, the winner takes all!
Whoever can survive the Nascent Soul Realm in the end will be able to swallow up all creation!
Yuqingshan is once again hidden from the world.
The dead Yuanying has no value in the eyes of Daojun Yuqing.
Daojun Xuantian closed his eyes in pain.
"The situation in Xuanyun Land has changed drastically. We need to have a good talk with Yuqing."
"If we can't negotiate, we can only hide from the world or escape to the wild world, so that Tianqi can inherit my orthodoxy."
As for what Demon Lord Taiyi said about the inheritance of Jiuyang to Lu Dongyang, even dogs don’t believe it!
He doesn't have much longevity, and although he is at the peak of his combat power, there are too many Nascent Souls on the opposite side!
In the previous Xuanyun Land, the three Nascent Souls on their side protected each other, ensuring each other's reincarnation and return, and the inheritance in an orderly manner.
But now, it's hard to say.
In the land of Xuanyun, the situation has changed drastically because Li Shuisheng was causing trouble everywhere, supporting Xuanji and killing Jiuyang!
In the Jiuyang Demon Sect, Li Shuisheng and Empress Jin Ao were fighting fiercely.
Li Shuisheng struck the Qiankun Fortune Palm one after another, causing Empress Jin Ao to cough up blood.
But thousands of miles away, everything has settled.
Daojun Xuantian and Daojun Yuqing finally chose to bow their heads.
Empress Jin Ao said angrily: "Why is this Jiuyang such a waste!"
"He died too quickly. At least he struggled a little and got Xuantian Yuqing involved!"
"That's all, I've killed two human Nascent Souls, that's good."
"If we continue to stir up trouble, it will make the human race suspicious and discover the big thing we are planning!"
Empress Jin Ao smiled at Li Shuisheng and said, "Although I didn't fully achieve the plan this time, I accomplished part of it."
"I won't play with you this time, we will meet again eventually!"
The golden threads on True Lord Lieyang's body disappeared, and Empress Jin Ao let go of True Lord Lieyang's control.
True Lord Lieyang felt that Empress Jin Ao had left, and looked at Li Shuisheng with his whole body trembling.
"Great True Lord Xuanming...I..."
Li Shuisheng smiled and said, "What are you?"
